findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which increases the risk associated with long-lived cryptographic keys and weakens the encryption posture over time.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default access
findings.description: No key policy is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default AWS-managed policy that grants full access to the entire AWS account (all IAM principals with appropriate IAM permissions), which can lead to overly broad access to encrypt/decrypt operations.
